title: Improved Analysis for Hessian-free High-resolution Monte Carlo Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2608.25052v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hessian-free high-resolution (HFHR) dynamics augments underdamped Langevin dynamics (ULD) with reversible position diffusion for sampling problems that arise in machine learning. We establish an explicit quantitative contraction rate for HFHR dynamics under a position Poincar\'e inequality, weighted Hessian and Laplacian bounds, and a compact Sobolev embedding, where the potential function is not necessarily convex. An adapted time-augmented Poincar\'e inequality yields an explicit rate that improves upon the contraction rate of the underdamped Langevin dynamics. We also give a weak-solution construction and a self-contained spectral proof of the divergence lemma underlying the argument. For HFHR Monte Carlo (HFHRMC) algorithm, which is based on a discretization scheme of HFHR dynamics, we use a path-space Girsanov argument to obtain a non-asymptotic convergence bound and an explicit iteration complexity in total variation distance. translated_title: 改进的无海森矩阵高分辨率蒙特卡洛采样分析
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.25052v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：无海森矩阵高分辨率（HFHR）动力学通过可逆位置扩散增强欠阻尼朗之万动力学（ULD），用于机器学习中出现的采样问题。我们在位置庞加莱不等式、加权海森矩阵和拉普拉斯界以及紧致索博列夫嵌入条件下，建立了HFHR动力学的显式定量收缩率，其中势函数不一定凸。一个适应的时间增广庞加莱不等式产生了显式速率，该速率优于欠阻尼朗之万动力学的收缩率。我们还给出了弱解构造和支撑论证的散度引理的自包含谱证明。对于基于HFHR动力学离散化方案的HFHR蒙特卡洛（HFHRMC）算法，我们使用路径空间Girsanov论证获得了非渐近收敛界和总变差距离下的显式迭代复杂度。
tldr: 本文为无海森矩阵高分辨率动力学提供了改进的显式收缩率和非渐近收敛分析，在非凸势下优于欠阻尼朗之万方法。
en_tdlr: This paper provides improved explicit contraction rates and non-asymptotic convergence analysis for Hessian-free high-resolution dynamics, outperforming underdamped Langevin methods under non-convex potentials.
